description_en: Modifies the ports used by Bastionhost for the RDP and SSH protocols on hosts. By default, Bastionhost uses port 3389 for RDP and port 22 for SSH. If you have configured custom ports on your hosts, you can call this operation to update the port settings
description_zh: 堡垒机对于服务器的RDP和SSH协议使用的是默认端口（RDP协议默认使用3389端口，SSH协议默认使用22端口），如果您在主机中自定义了端口，可通过本接口进行修改
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-hosts-port --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-ids '["1","2","3"]' --protocol-name SSH --port 22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHostsPort

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where the hosts whose protocol ports you want to modify reside.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
要修改协议端口的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the hosts whose ports you want to modify reside.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要修改端口的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts whose O&M protocols and ports you want to modify. The value is a JSON string. You can enter up to 100 host IDs. Separate multiple host IDs with commas (,).
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the host IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要修改运维协议和端口的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多可输入100个主机ID。多个主机ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the protocol whose port you want to modify. Valid values:
SSH
RDP
parameters.help_zh:
要修改端口的协议名称。取值：
SSH
RDP
parameters.name: protocol_name

parameters.help_en: The new port number. The port number must be an integer. Valid values: 22 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的端口号。端口号为整数，取值范围：22~65535
parameters.name: port

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is generated by Alibaba Cloud and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Code.description_en:
The result of the operation. Valid values:
OK: The operation is successful.
UNEXPECTED: An unknown error occurred.
INVALID_ARGUMENT: A request parameter is invalid.

Check the request parameters and try again.

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The specified object does not exist.

Check whether the Bastionhost instance ID and host ID are valid and whether the host exists, and then try again.

OBJECT_AlREADY_EXISTS: The specified object already exists
Code.description_zh:
接口调用的结果。取值：
OK：操作成功。
UNEXPECTED：未知错误。
INVALID_ARGUMENT：请求参数设置错误。

请检查请求参数，确保参数正确后重新调用接口。

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND：操作的对象不存在。

请检查该堡垒机实例的ID是否存在，主机是否存在，主机ID是否填写正确，然后重新调用接口。

OBJECT_AlREADY_EXISTS ：操作的对象已存在
